descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de electrocasnice, electrice și electronice
Miele Tehnica is a subsidiary of Miele & Cie. KG, Germany. We produce electronic components for a wide range of Miele appliances, such as washing machines, tumble dryers, vacuum cleaners, ovens and other household appliances. The products Miele offers to its customers set the standards for durability, performance, ease of use, energy efficiency, design and service.
 Responsibilities 
Define, implement, execute, and maintain automated tests systematically using Python and pytest
Analyze requirements and define, execute, and evaluate manual test scenarios
Specify and run manual and automated tests for the application, both in simulated environments and on the target embedded platform
Take ownership for design, execute, and evaluate software tests across different test levels, with a strong focus on integration testing 
Evaluate test results, analyze failures, and systematically narrow down the root causes of defects
Contribute to CI/CD-based automated test execution 
Build expertise, define best practices, and ensure that testing knowledge is shared across the QA team
 Your Profile 
Several years of experience in testing embedded software
Strong practical experience with Python and pytest 
Strong expertise in designing, implementing, maintaining, executing, and evaluating automated software tests
Experience with various test levels, especially integration testing 
Understanding of embedded systems, interfaces, and hardware-related software 
Experience working with hardware
Ability to evaluate test results and systematically identify potential causes of defects
Experience with CI/CD environments and automated test execution
Knowledge of common tools for version control and defect tracking, for example Git and Jira 
Fluent English; knowledge of German is an advantage
 Nice to Have 
ISTQB certification
Experience with Agile development environments
Additional experience with embedded software test frameworks or hardware-in-the-loop testing is an advantage
 About You 
Proactive, analytical solution seeker who resolves issues before they reach escalation level
Thinks in solutions and is driven by results
Independent, structured, and reliable working style
High quality awareness and strong analytical thinking skills
High standards of integrity and a strong sense of fairness
Positive attitude toward working in an international environment
Self-starter mindset with eagerness to tackle unknown topics
Ability and willingness to maintain close working relationships with software teams and team leaders
Strong teamwork skills and ability to give honest and constructive feedback
Available for occasional business travel for workshops and/or meetings
 Education 
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
 If you are looking for a long-term career where your talent is appreciated, then we would love for you to join our team!
